name: CIFAR-100
description: A labeled image dataset of 60,000 32×32 color images in 100 classes, with 500 training and 100 test images per class. The classes are grouped into 20 superclasses, and each image has fine and coarse labels.
citation: Krizhevsky, A. (2009). Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images. University of Toronto.
